subject: pol-con
title: (R)POL.CON.------TR.
description: Chart on book p. 413 (MID-W-7). POL-CON (political consciousness) is the subject, with the (R) prefix, "the reality of"; TR (transformation) is the partner. From the subject: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism) and RT-OP (reality options). From DYM-F: INFO-CON (information convergence) and C-FO-ACT (composite focused activism). From RT-OP: TH-AF-ALGN (thrust affinity alignment). From TH-AF-ALGN: INTR (interpretation).
